messages:
Maya Ortiz: Heads-up — Meridian wants Private deploy with Dedicated pricing but air-gapped. asking if we can avoid a full custom SOW.
Raj Patel: Can we map to an "Airgap Add-on" SKU: annual GPU commit (dedicated rates) + per-node ops fee + optional PS days?
Leo Zhang: Eng note: offline upgrades, signed packages, and disabled webhooks required. minimal work: feature flags + offline package pipeline ~3 sprints.
Nina Brooks (Finance): Recommend blended model: commit revenue + fixed $/node/mo to cover ops; amortize install PS across year1.
Samir Gupta (Legal): No-egress clause ok but must list allowed telemetry endpoints in Annex A and include liability carveouts. I'll draft template.
Maya Ortiz: Launch checklist for Sales pitch: 1) runbook bullets for installs, 2) pricing cells (commit + node fee + PS), 3) legal annex starter.
Raj Patel: I'll post a simple pricing grid CSV and two TCO scenarios by EOD.
Leo Zhang: I'll paste the minimal runbook checklist and an 8–12 week rollout timeline by 5pm.
contract-bot: Reminder — upload NDA/contract draft to ContractHub for redlines.
Maya Ortiz: Good — if we can present two clear options (higher commit = lower ops fee vs lower commit = higher ops fee) Meridian will pick. I'll run this tomorrow. :thumbsup:
